definition: Final rank of the distinct evolutionary group after joining its deterministic lead DeepClust cluster to the integrated structural result.
interpretation_or_caution: This is the principal ordering for the group-level final review lists; lower is better. It is not an experimental validation rank.

definition: Number of ranked pockets retained per structurally assessed member in the sensitivity analysis.
interpretation_or_caution: The v0.14.0 sensitivity authority used top five pockets. This is not the number of pockets that passed.

definition: Fraction of expected group members supported at the same three-dimensional pocket position when any of the retained top-k pockets may match.
interpretation_or_caution: Sensitivity result; compare with the primary selected-pocket result and do not substitute it silently for the primary gate.

definition: Fraction of expected group members with a fully conserved three-dimensional pocket under the top-k sensitivity rule.
interpretation_or_caution: Sensitivity result showing how pocket-choice uncertainty changes support; it is not the primary decision field.

definition: Number of member accessions whose same-position support changes from unsupported under the primary pocket to supported under the top-k sensitivity rule.
interpretation_or_caution: Counts accessions rescued by alternate pocket selection, not newly generated structures.

definition: Number of member accessions whose full 3D conservation support changes from unsupported under the primary pocket to supported under the top-k sensitivity rule.
interpretation_or_caution: A rescue indicates sensitivity to pocket choice and should be reviewed alongside the primary result.

definition: Group-level categorical conclusion for same-position 3D pocket support under the top-k sensitivity analysis.
interpretation_or_caution: Status values distinguish supported, not supported and not assessed; they are not booleans with missing values treated as false.

definition: Group-level categorical conclusion for fully conserved 3D-pocket support under the top-k sensitivity analysis.
interpretation_or_caution: This sensitivity conclusion does not replace three_dimensional_alignment_status in the configured primary gate.

definition: Rank of the distinct evolutionary group before ligandability and structural evidence were integrated.
interpretation_or_caution: Lower is better. Differences from final_evolutionary_rank show reordering caused by structural evidence.

definition: Stable compound identifier formed as primary_group_type:primary_group_id.
interpretation_or_caution: Use this key for joins at evolutionary-group level; do not join group tables by lead_cluster_id alone.

definition: OrthoFinder grouping level chosen as the primary evolutionary unit for the candidate.
interpretation_or_caution: Usually a hierarchical orthogroup; interpret primary_group_id in the context of this type.

definition: Identifier of the primary OrthoFinder orthogroup or hierarchical orthogroup.
interpretation_or_caution: It is not a DeepClust cluster identifier and should not be conflated with lead_cluster_id.

definition: DeepClust cluster selected deterministically to supply the group-facing detailed evidence record.
interpretation_or_caution: The lead is the best computationally ranked contributor; a group may contain multiple contributing clusters.

definition: Pre-structure computational rank of the deterministic lead DeepClust cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: This is a cluster rank, whereas prestructure_evolutionary_group_rank is a distinct-group rank.

definition: Number of DeepClust clusters assigned to the same primary evolutionary group.
interpretation_or_caution: Values above one show that several discovery clusters were consolidated into one evolutionary candidate.

definition: Semicolon-delimited DeepClust cluster identifiers contributing to the evolutionary group.
interpretation_or_caution: Use the contributor relation for row-level details; this field is a compact audit summary.

definition: Maximum prestructure_score among all contributing DeepClust clusters in the evolutionary group.
interpretation_or_caution: This is a group aggregate and can differ from a displayed lead field only if ranking tie-breaking requires it.

definition: Arithmetic mean prestructure_score across all contributing DeepClust clusters in the evolutionary group.
interpretation_or_caution: Describes within-group average strength; it is not used as the lead cluster's final structural score.

definition: Minimum prestructure_score among all contributing DeepClust clusters in the evolutionary group.
interpretation_or_caution: Use with the mean and best scores to judge within-group heterogeneity.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited OrthoFinder orthogroup identifiers associated with the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. May contain multiple alternative assignments; primary_group_id records the selected primary unit.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited OrthoFinder hierarchical orthogroup identifiers associated with the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. These retain hierarchy-aware alternatives and should not be collapsed into ordinary orthogroup IDs.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of non-primary OrthoFinder group assignments retained for the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Indicates grouping ambiguity/alternatives; primary_group_id is the chosen operational group.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of candidate protein accessions represented in the cluster-level record.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. A record count, not a species count; several accessions may belong to one species.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited candidate protein accessions associated with the lead cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. This is a compact list; use normalized member tables for species, sequence and mapping detail.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of configured target species present in the primary orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Use target_species_fraction for normalized coverage.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's total number of target species configured for the prioritisation profile.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator for target_species_fraction; the v0.14.0 profile used 12.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of configured target species represented in the candidate's orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator is target_species_total; species absence and unavailable downstream evidence are separate concepts.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited configured target species represented in the orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Species-level orthology presence, not proof of domain, expression or structure evidence.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited configured target species absent from the orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Absence at orthology stage is different from downstream evidence being unavailable.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of configured mandatory species represented in the orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Use with mandatory_species_total and mandatory_species_missing.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's total number of species configured as mandatory for the profile.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator for mandatory_species_fraction.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of configured mandatory species represented in the candidate's orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator is mandatory_species_total; this is an orthology coverage measure.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited mandatory species absent from the orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Any configured mandatory-species requirement should be interpreted using this explicit list.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of domain-assessed species with the required domain/E3 support.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Assessed negative and unavailable species have separate counts and lists.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of target-present species for which domain evidence supported a positive or assessed-negative conclusion.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator for domain_species_fraction.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of target-present species lacking an assessable domain annotation result.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Unavailable is missing evidence, not an assessed negative.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of target-present species with assessable domain evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Coverage denominator is target-species presence; separate from the positive support fraction.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of domain-assessed species that support the required E3/domain criterion.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Assessed negative and unavailable species are reported separately; unavailable is not zero support.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited species with positive required-domain support.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Species list corresponding to domain_supported_species_count.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited species assessed for domain evidence but not supporting the required criterion.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. These are true assessed negatives and must remain separate from unavailable species.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited target-present species without assessable domain evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Missing/unavailable evidence; do not count as negative support.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of expression-assessed species with at least one uniquely mapped candidate member classified as broadly expressed.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Numerator for expression_species_fraction.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of target-present species with any candidate-linked expression availability before unique-mapping assessment.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Availability is broader than assessability and can include ambiguous mappings.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of target-present species with at least one uniquely mapped expression row yielding BROAD or LIMITED evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator for expression_species_fraction; unavailable species are excluded rather than scored zero.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's number of target-present species with no uniquely mapped assessable expression conclusion.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Missing evidence count; not a count of low-expression species.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's expression_assessed_species_count divided by target_species_count.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Measures expression evidence completeness, while expression_species_fraction measures support among assessed species.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of expression-assessed target species supporting broad expression for at least one mapped member.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Denominator is expression_assessed_species_count, not all target species. The stringent gate threshold is 0.80.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited expression-assessed species supporting broad expression.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. A species is supported if any uniquely mapped candidate member passes the broad-expression rule.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited expression-assessed species classified as LIMITED rather than BROAD.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. True assessed negatives under the configured rule; distinct from unavailable species.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited target-present species without a uniquely mapped assessable expression conclusion.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Never interpret these species as zero expression.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of matched known E3 seed identifiers that are reviewed in the source annotation.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Discovery support feature; reviewed status does not validate the new candidate experimentally.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of matched seed identifiers with positive ubiquitin-system GO support.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Discovery evidence fraction derived from seed annotations.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of matched seed identifiers carrying configured exclusion-associated GO annotations.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Higher values weaken discovery support; inspect the exact seed records for interpretation.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's normalized component score summarising discovery-cluster seed support and exclusion evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. One component of prestructure_score; not an independent experimental confidence.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's normalized component score for target and mandatory species representation in the orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Weighted at 0.35 in prestructure_score under the final profile.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's normalized component score for required-domain support across domain-assessed species.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Weighted at 0.20 in prestructure_score; missing coverage is recorded separately.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's normalized component score derived from expression_species_fraction when expression evidence is assessable.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Missing expression is retained explicitly; no assessed evidence does not constitute a stringent expression pass.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's fraction of the major evidence dimensions with sufficient assessable data for the record.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. A completeness measure, not a biological support score.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's categorical summary of the configured pre-structure grant-aligned criteria.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Read with explicit inclusion, exclusion and missing-evidence fields.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's boolean indicating that all configured stringent pre-structure criteria pass.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Precedes structural assessment; not equivalent to grant_aligned_final_pass.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's boolean indicating that the evolutionary group fell within the configured top-200 distinct groups selected for structural analysis.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Selection for computation is not a structural pass or experimental recommendation.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited reasons why the record was retained or positively supported in pre-structure prioritisation.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Human-readable audit text; use the explicit gate fields for programmatic logic.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited pre-structure reasons preventing a stringent pass.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. These are assessed failures; missing_evidence separately records unavailable evidence.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's semicolon-delimited description of evidence that was unavailable or could not be assessed.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Missing evidence must never be recoded as a negative result or numeric zero.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's name of the configured prioritisation/scoring profile that produced the record.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Scores from different profiles should not be compared without checking their configurations.

definition: Deterministic lead DeepClust cluster's release-wide interpretation statement attached to the result row.
interpretation_or_caution: Lead-cluster snapshot, not an aggregate across every contributing cluster. Explicitly states that the result is computational prioritisation and requires experimental validation.

definition: Final integrated rank of the deterministic lead DeepClust cluster after structural evidence was added.
interpretation_or_caution: Cluster-level rank; final_evolutionary_rank is the preferred ordering for distinct evolutionary candidates.

definition: Rank among clusters passing the configured base grant-aligned gate before any required 3D-alignment gate.
interpretation_or_caution: Blank means the cluster did not pass grant_aligned_base_pass. In v0.14.0 all rows are blank because the base gate had zero passes.

definition: Rank among clusters passing every configured final gate, including required 3D pocket alignment where enabled.
interpretation_or_caution: Blank means the final gate did not pass. It must not be read as a poor numeric rank.

definition: Review-list label indicating whether the group is structurally supported or requires boss review with explicit evidence gaps.
interpretation_or_caution: Added to top review-list files; it is a review-routing label, not a scientific pass by itself.

definition: Cluster-level recommendation label derived from final gate status and the configured candidate limit.
interpretation_or_caution: Possible meanings include priority recommendation, stringent pass outside the limit, or further evidence/review required.

definition: Plain-language classification of whether all configured grant-aligned computational gates passed.
interpretation_or_caution: Not grant-aligned is not equivalent to biologically inactive; it records failure or non-assessment of one or more computational gates.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Weighted pre-structure score: 0.10 discovery + 0.35 orthology + 0.20 domain + 0.35 expression.
interpretation_or_caution: A prioritisation score on a 0-1 scale, not a probability of experimental success.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Integrated cluster-level ligandability score derived from selected-pocket quality and member-level structural assessments.
interpretation_or_caution: Higher is better under the configured profile; inspect component fields and missingness before comparing close values.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Cluster-level score summarising conservation of the selected pocket region across assessed members.
interpretation_or_caution: Sequence-region conservation is distinct from same-position or fully conserved 3D-pocket support.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Score summarising group-level three-dimensional pocket alignment and residue/chemical conservation evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Only interpretable when three_dimensional_alignment_status is not NOT_ASSESSED.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Primary-analysis categorical conclusion on whether assessed member pockets occupy the same 3D position.
interpretation_or_caution: Same-position support is weaker than full conserved-pocket support; missing/non-assessed is not negative evidence.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Primary-analysis categorical conclusion on whether the 3D pocket is positionally and chemically/residually conserved.
interpretation_or_caution: This is the configured primary 3D gate; the sensitivity status is reported separately.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Mean across assessed members of the minimum TM-score used for structural alignment support.
interpretation_or_caution: A 0-1 structural-similarity measure; inspect coverage and status rather than treating it alone as a pass.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Mean fraction of selected-pocket residues spatially overlapping the aligned reference pocket across assessed members.
interpretation_or_caution: Fraction is 0-1 and is conditional on successful structural mapping/alignment.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Median distance in angstroms between aligned pocket centroids across assessed comparisons.
interpretation_or_caution: Lower generally indicates closer positional agreement; interpret with overlap and TM-score.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Mean fraction of reference pocket positions that could be matched structurally across assessed members.
interpretation_or_caution: Measures mappability of pocket positions, not amino-acid identity.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Mean exact amino-acid identity fraction at structurally matched pocket positions.
interpretation_or_caution: A strict residue identity measure; chemical-group conservation can remain higher.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Mean fraction of structurally matched pocket positions retaining the configured amino-acid chemical group.
interpretation_or_caution: Uses grouped chemical similarity and is less strict than exact identity.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Integrated structural score, normally 0.55 ligandability + 0.45 pocket conservation, with configured 3D refinement when assessed.
interpretation_or_caution: Composite score; gate fields, not score alone, determine grant-aligned pass status.

category: 6. Integrated structural scores and final gates
definition: Integrated prioritisation score: 0.60 prestructure_score + 0.40 structural_score.
interpretation_or_caution: Orders review candidates but does not override hard evidence gates.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: expression_assessed_species_count divided by target_species_count.
interpretation_or_caution: Measures expression evidence completeness, while expression_species_fraction measures support among assessed species.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Semicolon-delimited expression-assessed species supporting broad expression.
interpretation_or_caution: A species is supported if any uniquely mapped candidate member passes the broad-expression rule.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Semicolon-delimited expression-assessed species classified as LIMITED rather than BROAD.
interpretation_or_caution: True assessed negatives under the configured rule; distinct from unavailable species.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Semicolon-delimited target-present species without a uniquely mapped assessable expression conclusion.
interpretation_or_caution: Never interpret these species as zero expression.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Fraction of matched known E3 seed identifiers that are reviewed in the source annotation.
interpretation_or_caution: Discovery support feature; reviewed status does not validate the new candidate experimentally.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Fraction of matched seed identifiers with positive ubiquitin-system GO support.
interpretation_or_caution: Discovery evidence fraction derived from seed annotations.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Fraction of matched seed identifiers carrying configured exclusion-associated GO annotations.
interpretation_or_caution: Higher values weaken discovery support; inspect the exact seed records for interpretation.

definition: Normalized component score summarising discovery-cluster seed support and exclusion evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: One component of prestructure_score; not an independent experimental confidence.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Normalized component score for target and mandatory species representation in the orthology group.
interpretation_or_caution: Weighted at 0.35 in prestructure_score under the final profile.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Normalized component score for required-domain support across domain-assessed species.
interpretation_or_caution: Weighted at 0.20 in prestructure_score; missing coverage is recorded separately.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Normalized component score derived from expression_species_fraction when expression evidence is assessable.
interpretation_or_caution: Missing expression is retained explicitly; no assessed evidence does not constitute a stringent expression pass.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Fraction of the major evidence dimensions with sufficient assessable data for the record.
interpretation_or_caution: A completeness measure, not a biological support score.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Categorical summary of the configured pre-structure grant-aligned criteria.
interpretation_or_caution: Read with explicit inclusion, exclusion and missing-evidence fields.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Boolean indicating that all configured stringent pre-structure criteria pass.
interpretation_or_caution: Precedes structural assessment; not equivalent to grant_aligned_final_pass.

category: 4. Pre-structure species, domain and expression evidence
definition: Boolean indicating that the evolutionary group fell within the configured top-200 distinct groups selected for structural analysis.
interpretation_or_caution: Selection for computation is not a structural pass or experimental recommendation.

definition: Sample identifier parsed from the discovery representative's source file.
interpretation_or_caution: Source-file provenance; it may differ from the normalized representative_sample_id.

definition: Species label parsed from the discovery representative's source file.
interpretation_or_caution: Retained to audit source naming against normalized species.

definition: Normalized sample identifier for the discovery-cluster representative sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: Use with representative_species and representative_source_path for provenance.

definition: Normalized species assigned to the discovery-cluster representative sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: Representative origin does not imply that the whole cluster is species-specific.

definition: Taxonomic identifier associated with the representative sequence where available.
interpretation_or_caution: Blank values mean the source did not provide a resolved taxon identifier.

definition: Named proteome identifier associated with the representative sequence where available.
interpretation_or_caution: Blank for 1KP or other sources without a named proteome identifier.

definition: 1KP sample code associated with the representative sequence where applicable.
interpretation_or_caution: Specific to 1KP provenance; blank for named-proteome representatives.

definition: Original unmodified identifier of the representative sequence in the source data.
interpretation_or_caution: Preserves traceability when normalized identifiers differ.

definition: Parsed database entry/accession for the representative sequence where one can be extracted.
interpretation_or_caution: May be blank for scaffold-style 1KP identifiers.

definition: Amino-acid length of the discovery-cluster representative sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: Sequence length is a provenance/QC attribute, not a ranking score.

definition: MD5 digest of the representative amino-acid sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: Use to verify exact sequence identity independently of labels.

definition: Source file path recorded for the representative sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: Provenance path from the producing environment; it may not exist on another machine.

definition: Number of known E3 seed sequences represented by discovery matches before seed-ID deduplication.
interpretation_or_caution: Sequence count can exceed unique seed count when several sequences map to one seed identifier.

definition: Number of unique known E3 seed identifiers associated with the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Unique seed count used for annotation-derived fractions.

definition: Semicolon-delimited known E3 seed identifiers associated with the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Compact audit list; consult the seed authority for full annotations.

definition: Number of seed sequence records matched to the cluster under the discovery matching rules.
interpretation_or_caution: Counts sequence records, not necessarily unique seed identifiers.

definition: Number of unique seed identifiers matched to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Denominator for several seed annotation summaries.

definition: Semicolon-delimited unique seed identifiers calculated from the matched seed records.
interpretation_or_caution: Recomputed audit field used to verify annotated seed counts and IDs.

definition: Number of matched seed sequences satisfying the strict discovery threshold.
interpretation_or_caution: Subset of matched_seed_sequence_count.

definition: Number of matched seed sequences failing the strict discovery threshold but retained in raw evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Retained for audit; not counted as strict support.

definition: Number of matched unique seed identifiers with usable seed annotation.
interpretation_or_caution: Can be smaller than matched_seed_id_count when annotations are unavailable.

definition: Number of distinct seed categories represented among matched annotated seeds.
interpretation_or_caution: Category diversity descriptor, not a pass criterion by itself.

definition: Semicolon-delimited seed categories represented in the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Human-readable summary of seed-family evidence.

definition: Semicolon-delimited review-status values for matched seeds.
interpretation_or_caution: Mixed values can occur; reviewed_seed_fraction provides the numeric summary.

definition: Semicolon-delimited ubiquitin-system GO support statuses for matched seeds.
interpretation_or_caution: Source values behind ubiquitin_go_positive_seed_fraction.

definition: Semicolon-delimited source organisms of matched known E3 seeds.
interpretation_or_caution: Seed-organism diversity does not equal target-species coverage.

definition: Semicolon-delimited protein names of matched known E3 seeds.
interpretation_or_caution: Useful for biological interpretation; names are not stable join keys.

definition: Number of matched unique seed identifiers annotated as reviewed.
interpretation_or_caution: Numerator behind reviewed_seed_fraction.

definition: Number of matched unique seed identifiers with positive ubiquitin-system GO support.
interpretation_or_caution: Numerator behind ubiquitin_go_positive_seed_fraction.

definition: Number of matched unique seeds carrying a configured exclusion-associated GO term.
interpretation_or_caution: Positive count contributes to exclusion_flag_fraction; inspect terms before biological conclusions.

definition: Number of raw discovery-cluster member sequences before strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Includes members that fail strict identity/coverage criteria.

definition: Number of discovery-cluster members satisfying the strict matching criteria.
interpretation_or_caution: Subset of raw_member_count.

definition: Number of strict cluster members that are not known seed sequences and therefore form candidate evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: Candidate-sequence count, not unique species count.

definition: strict_member_count divided by raw_member_count.
interpretation_or_caution: Cluster purity/retention fraction under the strict filter.

definition: strict_nonseed_candidate_count divided by raw_member_count.
interpretation_or_caution: Fraction of the raw cluster retained as strict non-seed candidate members.

definition: Raw sample count reported by the discovery summary source.
interpretation_or_caution: Retained alongside the recalculated value to expose reporting discrepancies.

definition: Raw species count reported by the discovery summary source.
interpretation_or_caution: Retained alongside the recalculated value to expose reporting discrepancies.

definition: Distinct raw sample count recalculated from member records.
interpretation_or_caution: Use as the reproducible member-derived raw sample count.

definition: Distinct raw species count recalculated from member records.
interpretation_or_caution: Use as the reproducible member-derived raw species count.

definition: Number of distinct 1KP samples represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Source-specific coverage count before strict filtering.

definition: Number of distinct normalized 1KP species represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Source-specific species coverage before strict filtering.

definition: Number of distinct named proteomes represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Does not include 1KP samples without named proteome IDs.

definition: Number of distinct species from named proteomes represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Source-specific species coverage before strict filtering.

definition: Semicolon-delimited named proteome identifiers represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Compact provenance list before strict filtering.

definition: Number of configured named cereal proteomes represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Taxonomic coverage summary before strict filtering.

definition: Number of configured named Solanaceae proteomes represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Taxonomic coverage summary before strict filtering.

definition: Number of configured named legume proteomes represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Taxonomic coverage summary before strict filtering.

definition: Number of configured named Brassicaceae proteomes represented among raw members.
interpretation_or_caution: Taxonomic coverage summary before strict filtering.

definition: Number of distinct samples represented after strict discovery filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter sample coverage; compare with raw_sample_count_calculated.

definition: Number of distinct species represented after strict discovery filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter species coverage; compare with raw_species_count_calculated.

definition: Number of distinct 1KP samples represented after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter 1KP sample coverage.

definition: Number of distinct normalized 1KP species represented after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter 1KP species coverage.

definition: Number of distinct named proteomes represented after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter named-proteome coverage.

definition: Number of distinct named-proteome species represented after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter named-species coverage.

definition: Semicolon-delimited named proteome identifiers retained after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Compact post-filter provenance list.

definition: Number of configured named cereal proteomes retained after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter cereal coverage summary.

definition: Number of configured named Solanaceae proteomes retained after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter Solanaceae coverage summary.

definition: Number of configured named legume proteomes retained after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter legume coverage summary.

definition: Number of configured named Brassicaceae proteomes retained after strict filtering.
interpretation_or_caution: Post-filter Brassicaceae coverage summary.

definition: Minimum observed pairwise percent identity among discovery matches contributing to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Reported in percentage points (0-100), not as a 0-1 fraction.

definition: Median observed pairwise percent identity among discovery matches contributing to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Reported in percentage points (0-100).

definition: Maximum observed pairwise percent identity among discovery matches contributing to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Reported in percentage points (0-100).

definition: Minimum observed member-sequence alignment coverage among discovery matches contributing to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Reported in percentage points (0-100), not as a 0-1 fraction.

definition: Median member-sequence alignment coverage among discovery matches contributing to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Reported in percentage points (0-100).

definition: Maximum member-sequence alignment coverage among discovery matches contributing to the cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Reported in percentage points (0-100).

definition: Number of normalized protein-member rows linked to the lead cluster's selected OrthoFinder group.
interpretation_or_caution: Row/member count; may exceed species count because a species can contribute multiple proteins.

definition: Number of distinct species represented among normalized members of the selected OrthoFinder group.
interpretation_or_caution: May include more species than the configured target subset.

definition: Number of normalized domain-summary rows linked to the lead cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: A provenance/QC count, not a count of positive species.

definition: Number of normalized candidate-expression summary rows linked to the lead cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: A linked evidence-row count, not the 32,981,864 tissue-context row count and not a support score.

definition: Number of selected-pocket records linked to the lead cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Counts primary selected pockets across assessed members; it is not member_pocket_top_k.

definition: Number of member-level pocket-conservation records linked to the lead cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: A processed member-record count; inspect structural_species_fraction for coverage.
